scope: Make authenticated PRE-CU combat select its Core3 hit/secondary-defense route before inherited NGE result tables, preserve authored three-pool HAM costs, and migrate persisted NGE display-only combat statistics without recreating them.

findings: Publish 14.1 attack admission, primary accuracy, secondary defense, and HAM costs are skill-, weapon-, posture-, and command-authored rather than expertise-driven.
All retained profession and NPC combat actions are already authenticated by precu_combat_overrides.tab, and every row supplies an explicit target pool and PRE-CU HAM-cost model.

The previous dispatcher could select the inherited NGE hit tables through a fallback sentinel even after entering PRE-CU resolution; current complete family profiles made that unlikely, but the control-flow boundary was not fail-closed.

Single-target PRE-CU actions reached the inherited success-based free-shot helper after their authored HAM cost was calculated, allowing five NGE freeshot skill modifiers to replace the cost with zero.
Area costs remain drained once before the hit engine; their per-defender success-cost result must remain zero to prevent duplicate drains.
The authenticated Publish-era stripped-skillmod corpus has SHA-256 b2520748b03006faef7357372ea1e7eb7adbe5e52a8abd34db604b48a3e513a3 and contains zero display_only_* combat-stat keys.

The inherited NGE expertise listing retains thirteen display_only_* rows, while base_player previously recalculated and rewrote thirteen NGE combat statistics after login, equipment, armor, buff, and skill-mod events.

Twenty-two production callbacks remain attached to the cleanup handler, which removes fourteen known legacy keys—including one cleanup-only historical key—without reading combat statistics or writing skill modifiers.

buildEvidence.sourceTest: passed; existing PRE-CU HAM/hit isolation remains intact, the player display handler preserves fourteen exact legacy cleanup keys and zero writers or combat-stat reads, all twenty-two production cleanup callbacks remain, and thirteen inherited NGE listing rows are bounded to unwritten compatibility metadata
buildEvidence.focusedJavaCompile: passed with Java 8 target in an ephemeral in-memory directory removed immediately; setDisplayOnlyDefensiveMods bytecode contains fourteen cleanup keys and removeAttribOrSkillModModifier with no addSkillModModifier call

auditBoundary.closedInThisMilestone: authenticated PRE-CU hit-result and action-cost dispatch cannot cross into inherited NGE expertise authority, and production player lifecycle callbacks can only remove—not recreate—the NGE display-only combat-stat surface
auditBoundary.preserved: Core3 primary and secondary defense, authored three-pool costs, one-time area cost draining, PRE-CU block/dodge/counter/ricochet, all twenty-two cleanup callback sites, inherited compatibility metadata for retained later content, and all expansion quests/zones
auditBoundary.notClaimedComplete: non-combat and content-specific expertise references, plus inherited combat helpers reachable only from non-authenticated later-content actions, remain subject to later reachability audits
